params.message:
Sources screen: which rows each adapter reads, and what each source brought in

/collection now passes each adapter's own sources patterns and its cadence, so
the Observatory can put every row in sources under the adapter that collects it,
matched by the same rule as claims(), and say how long an adapter rests.

The sources list carries signals30d: signals per source over the last 30 days,
one grouped count on the indexed source_id, with the same window as /mix.
